Sandbox_WashSmart_AllowTaintedWater: Allow Tainted Water to Clean Rags
Sandbox_WashSmart_AllowTaintedWater_tool: When enabled, tainted water can be used to clean rags, bandages and strips.
Sandbox_WashSmart_BandageWaterPerItem_to: Water units used per item when washing dirty bandages, rags, denim strips, and leather strips at a water source. Default: 4.0.
